meta.purpose: Frozen V6.4.4 baseline + Goodhart/holdout set from ACTUAL NGSPICE-BSIM-CMG-referenced sims (not markdown numbers). Instrumentation-only: no retrain, no checkpoint modification.
meta.ground_truth: NGSPICE BSIM-CMG (LEVEL=72), as used by the verify_complex_* scripts
meta.env: conda env pycircuitsim; OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 (VTC trip gain ~20x -> ~+/-1% scatter)
meta.checkpoints_dir: external_compact_models/bsimar/checkpoints/ (canonical V6.4.4 slots, read-only, BSIMAR_CHECKPOINT_DIR NOT set)

commands.ring_osc: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 conda run -n pycircuitsim python tests/verify_complex_ring_osc.py --tech TSMC5,TSMC7,TSMC12,TSMC16
commands.opamp: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 conda run -n pycircuitsim python tests/verify_complex_opamp.py --tech TSMC5,TSMC12
commands.sram_blind_corner: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 conda run -n pycircuitsim python tests/verify_complex_sram_snm.py --tech TSMC7 --nfin 3

roles.blind_veto: Selection-blind PASS/FAIL veto: NEVER used to pick adapters/seeds/lambda; any regression to FAIL vetoes promotion.
roles.protected_no_worsen: Out-of-scope gate protected as no-worsening; numeric diff only (gain no-worsening). TSMC12 opamp already FAILS so it is no-worsening-only, NOT a pass/fail veto.
roles.target: The gate(s) V6.4.6 is trying to close (must beat the recorded baseline).
roles.blind_sram_corner: Held-out SRAM NFIN corner never used in selection (NFIN=3 is off the default {2,5,10} grid); blind reference for Phase 1/3 SRAM work.

detail.note: Already FAILS at baseline -> no-worsening numeric diff only (gain 167.8 must not drop further), NOT a pass/fail veto.
